verify.title: Business not verified with Meta
verify.lead: The number works, but on a reduced limit of 250 unique recipients per day. Verification lifts the limit and unlocks a full launch. The studio has to do it itself — the WhatsApp account belongs to you, and Velora cannot pass it on your behalf.
verify.step1b: and hit “Start verification”. You need admin rights on the business account.
verify.step2: Fill in the legal details: the name exactly as in your documents, address, phone and website. The site must be live and served over HTTPS.
verify.step3: Upload a business registration document and wait for Meta to read it.
verify.step4: Confirm you are connected to the business: an email on your site's domain, a call or SMS to the listed phone, or domain verification.
verify.step5: Wait for the decision — usually 1–5 business days. The status is in the same Security Center; if rejected, Meta states the reason and lets you reapply.
verify.docsTitle: Which documents work (one from each group):
verify.doc1: Registration: certificate of incorporation, registry extract, business licence or a tax document.
verify.doc2: Proof of presence: a working website, an official social media page or a business directory listing.
verify.pitfall: The business name in Meta and in the document must match character for character, including the legal form and punctuation. “Romashka LLC” and “Romashka, LLC” count as different names.
